令和8年第1回定例会の議決結果

name: 乳児等通園支援事業を条例に追加
summary: 目黒区立保育所条例に、乳児等通園支援事業の規定はありません。議案はこの事業を条例に加え、利用時間に応じた費用を保護者から徴収する仕組みを設けます。条例は令和8年4月1日に施行され、利用手続きは施行日前から行えます。
changes: 乳児等通園支援事業を条例に追加する
国の基準で算定した額に利用時間を乗じた費用を徴収する
who: 乳児等通園支援事業の利用を承認された児童の保護者
why: 新たに乳児等通園支援事業を実施するためと、区長は説明しています。

en.name: Adds the infant and other children’s childcare support service to the ordinance
en.official: Ordinance Partially Amending the Meguro City Public Nursery School Ordinance
en.summary: The Meguro City Public Nursery School Ordinance does not contain provisions for the infant and other children’s childcare support service. The bill adds the service to the ordinance and establishes a system for collecting fees from parents or guardians based on the length of time used. The ordinance takes effect on April 1, 2026, and procedures for applying to use the service can begin before that date.
changes: Adds the service to the ordinance and provides for collecting a fee calculated by multiplying the amount calculated according to national standards by the time used
who: Parents or guardians of children approved to use the infant and other children’s childcare support service
en.why: The mayor says this is to start providing the infant and other children’s childcare support service.
